maps.name: Local Neighbourhood
maps.description: The Sun’s real neighbourhood: every known star system within about 13 light years, every confirmed planet host out to about 16.5 light years, and a few famous landmarks beyond (Altair, Vega, Zeta Reticuli, TRAPPIST-1). Positions are true 3D positions from Gaia, Hipparcos and SIMBAD astrometry; planets are limited to those listed as confirmed by the NASA Exoplanet Archive (July 2026). Star and planet parameters are real where measured and physics-derived where not.

maps.name: Local Neighbourhood (Science Fiction)
maps.description: The same real stars as the Local Neighbourhood map, at their true positions — but populated with the famous science fiction set among them. Sol runs on The Expanse; Pandora circles Alpha Centauri A; Reach guards Epsilon Eridani; the Nostromo is still answering that beacon at Zeta Reticuli. This map is deliberately fictional: the planets, stations and ships come from the novels, films and games, not from the catalogues. Stars without a famous fictional tenant keep their real confirmed planets.
